calls.title: Dream Cricket + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team discussed the configuration of GrowthBook’s SDK and feature flags to facilitate controlled experimentation for Dream Cricket. They explored user attribute targeting through multiple platform support, which allows for precise targeting based on various attributes like country and device ID. Feature flags were reviewed, including their types—Boolean, multivariate, and remote JSON configurations—and the ability to implement gradual rollouts to monitor feature health. The discussion also covered managing experiments through lightweight code, custom metrics defined by SQL queries, and data integration with BigQuery. A two-week enterprise trial was proposed for Dream Cricket to evaluate the product, complemented by a dedicated Slack channel for communication and support during the trial period.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation, GrowthBook SDK, data warehouse integration, namespace, gradual rollout
